Command.Comment: RAGIN positive mTLS app probe v2 via /api/session/command from EDGE (no secrets printed)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
REQ_ID="rrp-positive-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
SESSION_ID="live-positive-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
CERT_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt
KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.key
CA_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt
API_KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/api.key
echo REQ_ID=$REQ_ID
echo SESSION_ID=$SESSION_ID
CERTS_READY=0
API_KEY_READY=0
if [ -n "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -n "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -n "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -f "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CA_FILE" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
if [ -n "$API_KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$API_KEY_FILE" ]; then
  API_KEY_READY=1
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
echo API_KEY_READY=$API_KEY_READY
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && [ "$API_KEY_READY" = "1" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_TLS_VERIFY_EDGE_TO_CORE"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$CA_FILE" \
    -cert "$CERT_FILE" \
    -key "$KEY_FILE" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/tls_verify.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo TLS_VERIFY_EXIT=0
  else
    echo TLS_VERIFY_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- tls verify head ---"
  head -n 40 "${TMPDIR}/tls_verify.txt"
  echo "ATTEMPT_SESSION_CREATE"
  if curl -sS --max-time 30 --cert "$CERT_FILE" --key "$KEY_FILE" --cacert "$CA_FILE" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$API_KEY_FILE")" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"source_ip\":\"172.31.35.203\",\"max_commands\":10}" \
    https://172.31.17.217:8443/api/session/create > "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" 2>"${TMPDIR}/session_create_err.txt"; then
    echo SESSION_CREATE_EXIT=0
  else
    echo SESSION_CREATE_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- session_create head ---"
  head -n 200 "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" 2>/dev/null || echo SESSION_CREATE_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
  echo "--- session_create error head ---"
  head -n 200 "${TMPDIR}/session_create_err.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo SESSION_CREATE_ERR_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
  SESSION_TOKEN=""

  # extract session_token with jq
  if [ -f "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" ]; then
    SESSION_TOKEN=$(jq -r '.session_token // empty' "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  fi
  CREATE_SESSION_ID=""
  if [ -f "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" ]; then
    CREATE_SESSION_ID=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "${TMPDIR}/session_create.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  fi
  echo SESSION_TOKEN=$SESSION_TOKEN
  echo CREATE_SESSION_ID=$CREATE_SESSION_ID
  if [ -n "$SESSION_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$CREATE_SESSION_ID" ]; then
    echo "ATTEMPT_SESSION_COMMAND"
    if curl -sS --max-time 30 --cert "$CERT_FILE" --key "$KEY_FILE" --cacert "$CA_FILE" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$API_KEY_FILE")" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -H "X-Session-Token: $SESSION_TOKEN" \
      -d "{\"session_id\":\"$CREATE_SESSION_ID\",\"command\":\"id\",\"request_id\":\"$REQ_ID\"}" \
      https://172.31.17.217:8443/api/session/command > "${TMPDIR}/session_command.json" 2>"${TMPDIR}/session_command_err.txt"; then
      echo SESSION_COMMAND_EXIT=0
    else
      echo SESSION_COMMAND_EXIT=$?
    fi
    echo "--- session_command head ---"
    head -n 300 "${TMPDIR}/session_command.json" 2>/dev/null || echo SESSION_COMMAND_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
    echo "--- session_command error head ---"
    head -n 300 "${TMPDIR}/session_command_err.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo SESSION_COMMAND_ERR_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
  else
    echo SESSION_COMMAND_SKIPPED=no_token_or_no_session_id
  fi
else
  echo POSITIVE_PROBE_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_apikey_or_no_curl_or_no_jq
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
